Just like on Calgon&hellip;''"<br />"''But that wasn't my fault&hellip;|Two Rebel Alliance operatives, preparing to infiltrate a Galactic Empire asteroid base|<ref name="TRG1" />}}
'''Calgon''' was a terrestrial celestial body<ref name="TRG1" /> situated in the [[Calgon system/Legends|Calgon system]], a part of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Meridian sector/Legends|Meridian sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> At some point during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], a team of Rebel operatives unsuccessfully attempted to use stealth in approaching a target on Calgon. Later, one of the agents compared the incident to the team's plan of infiltrating an [[Unidentified Imperial asteroid base|Imperial asteroid base]] by using [[Grav-bike/Legends|grav-bikes]], to which their fellow operative replied that they were not to blame for the events on Calgon.<ref name="TRG1" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:AlNasrl-VoyagesSF13.png|thumb|right|250px|Calgon placed on a map of the Al'Nasrl sector included in ''Voyages SF'' 13.]]
Calgon was first mentioned in "[[Ain't Science Grand?]]," a [[roleplaying game]] adventure idea included in the [[1987]] [[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|rulebook]] for the first edition of [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="TRG1" /> "[[Twinkle, Twinkle Little Star, How I Wonder Where We Are]]," a [[1990]] [[roleplaying game]] source article published in the [[Voyages SF 13|thirteenth issue]] of the ''[[Voyages SF]]'' magazine, placed Calgon in the [[Al'Nasrl sector/Legends|Al'Nasrl sector]]. Since that article was released outside of the [[Lucas Licensing]] process,<ref name="Twinkle">{{VoyagesCite|13|Twinkle, Twinkle Little Star, How I Wonder Where We Are}}</ref> it was considered non-[[canon]]ical with respect to the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity.<ref name="UnlicensedStatus">{{UnlicensedStatus}}</ref> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' subsequently placed the Calgon [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the celestial body itself, in grid square R-7,<ref name="TEA" /> and the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to that book eventually overrode the ''Voyages SF'' 13 placement by instead placing it in the Meridian [[Sector/Legends|sector]].<ref name="EAOC" />
